name: 100% Specialty Arabica
description:
Smooth, naturally sweet Arabica with notes of caramel, butterscotch, roasted nuts and a bright plum-like finish.  
  Grown in Coorg and finished with an anaerobic red-honey process for a cleaner, more layered cup.

name: 100% Specialty Excelsa
description: A rare, resilient bean grown in select South Indian microclimates, hand picked and anaerobically processed for a complex, fruit forward cup. Expect a bold brew with notes of figs, grapes and almonds.

name: 100% Specialty Robusta
description: A bold Peridinia grown at 800 m in Coorg’s fertile terrain, absorbing the richness from wild fig, silver oak and native shrubs. Expect a naturally intense, high caffeine brew with juicy stone fruit notes.

name: NinetyTwo Pocket Pour
description: Our single-serve drip bags let you enjoy the full NinetyTwo experience wherever you are. Just add hot water to unlock bold flavour, rich aroma and the quiet ritual of a truly balanced brew.
